name: Idolm*ster Cinderella Produce
original_name: アイドル○スターシンデレラプロデュース
source:
"I work in the Producer Division of a major idol agency.
My job is to create and manage new idols.
A producer discovers talent, of course, but also cultivates that talent through various choices."

He's a producer who took an idol to the top and was brought down by scandal.
Now the fates of all girls are entrusted to him...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE116469.html]DLsite English[/url]]
